content:
Developers can now install macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2, with just a few weeks to go until the official release. Here are the highlights of this update.

macOS 27.2 beta 2 is now available

Last week, Apple released macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 1 to developers, skipping the macOS 27.1 Golden Gate beta testing cycle. The reason is believed to be that iOS 27.1 involves details that the company does not want to disclose in advance, and has not even fully revealed internally.

The most important new feature of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 1 at the user level is that Siri AI, which only supported English when macOS 27 Golden Gate launched last month, has now added five more languages.

Starting from macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 1, Siri AI also supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.

The build number of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2 is 26B5091g. We are testing the new beta in depth and will report back if we find anything important.

How to install macOS 27.2 beta 2

Here are the steps to install the first macOS 27.2 beta 2:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Click the 'i' icon next to 'Beta Updates'
  • Select 'macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta' from the dropdown menu in the top right corner
  • Click 'Done'

Have you found anything new in this macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
